pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍenti, pesale bhikkhū omasanti;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.3: jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsenti vambhenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍantā pesale bhikkhū omasissanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.6: jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsessanti vambhessantī”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū chabbaggiye bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasatha: jātiyāpi …pe… hīnenapi akkosena khuṃsetha vambhethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasissatha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.13: netaṃ mogha purisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, takkasilāyaṃ aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa nandivisālo nāma balivaddo ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.2: atha kho, bhikkhave, nandivisālo balivaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.3: “gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhutaṃ karohi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.5: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhutaṃ akāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.7: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā nandivisālaṃ balivaddaṃ yojetvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.9: atha kho, bhikkhave, nandivisālo balivaddo tattheva aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.10: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sahassena parājito pajjhāyi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.11: athakho bhikkhave nandivisālo balivaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.13: tathāhi panāhaṃ bho tayā sahassena parājitoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.14: kissa pana maṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.15: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhutaṃ karohi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.17: mā ca maṃ akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.18: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhutaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.20: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā nandivisālaṃ balivaddaṃ yojetvā etadavoca –
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.22: atha kho, bhikkhave, nandivisālo balivaddo sakaṭasataṃ atibaddhaṃ pavaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.30: kimaṅga pana etarahi manāpā bhavissati khuṃsanā vambhanā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.32: evañca pana bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.2: dasahi ākārehi omasati: jātiyāpi nāmenapi gottenapi kammenapi sippenapi ābādhenapi liṅgenapi kilesenapi āpattiyāpi akkosenapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.4: dve jātiyo, hīnā ca jāti ukkaṭṭhā ca jāti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.6: caṇḍālajāti veṇajāti nesādajāti rathakārajāti, pukkusajāti. esā hīnā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.8: khattiyajāti brāhmaṇajāti. esā ukkaṭṭhā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.10: dve nāmāni, hīnañca nāmaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca nāmaṃ .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.12: avakaṇṇakaṃ javakaṇṇakaṃ dhaniṭṭhakaṃ saviṭṭhakaṃ kulavaḍḍhakaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oñātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.14: buddhappaṭisaññūttaṃ dhammapaṭisaññuttaṃ saṅghapaṭisaññuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoñātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.16: dve gottāni, hīnañca gottaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.18: kosiyagottaṃ bhāradvājagottaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oñātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.20: gotamagottaṃ moggallānagottaṃ kaccānagottaṃ, vāseṭṭhagottaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.22: dve kammāni: hīnañca kammaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.24: koṭṭhakakammaṃ pupphachaḍḍakakammaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oñātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.26: kasi vaṇijjā, gorakkhā, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoñātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ. etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.28: dve sippāni, hīnañca sippaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca sippaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.30: naḷakārasippaṃ kumbhakārasippaṃ pesakārasippaṃ cammakārasippaṃ nahāpitasippaṃ, tesu tesu vā janapadesu oñātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ. etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.32: muddā gaṇanā lekhā, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoñātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.36: dve liṅgāni, hīnañca liṅgaṃ ukkaṭṭhañca liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.38: atidīghaṃ atirassaṃ atikaṇhaṃ accodātaṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.40: nātidīghaṃ nātirassaṃ nātikaṇhaṃ, nāccodātaṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.46: dve akkosā hīno ca akkoso ukkaṭṭho ca akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.48: oṭṭhosi, meṇḍosi, goṇosi, gadrabhosi, tiracchānagatosi, nerayikosi; natthī tuyhaṃ sugati, duggatiyeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāti, yakārena vā bhakārena vā, kāṭakoṭacikāya vā, eso hīno nāma akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.50: paṇḍitosi, vyattosi medhāvīsi bahussutosi dhammakathikosi, natthi tuyhaṃ duggati, sugatiyeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāti, eso ukkaṭṭho nāma akkoso.
